最近 Personal Agent 很火

对比了一下主流的 Personal Agent 的虚拟机配置，这么看老马是真下本啊。

Grokbot 从 CPU、内存、硬盘都给得很够，Dot 的配置也很高。

不过 Dot 好像不是独享虚拟机的，可能存在共用情况
Dot 这个限制比较多，不能用 SSH 连，玩法少了不少

还是对谷歌的 Gemini 4 比较期待，它的价格相较于 GPT-6 Astra 确实不是很贵。

而且这次比较亮眼、独有的，应该是它首次将输出长度扩展到了 100 万。

之前我们说的 100 万上下文只是输入长度可以很长，输出的话大部分都是 64K，直接把输出长度扩展到 100 万还是挺顶的。

我对谷歌的希望，就是它能有一个接近于国产模型头部的 Agent 或者 coding 能力，同时依旧维持它比较长板的写作能力和多模态能力，这样就已经很能打了

The White House Accord on Super Intelligence will have a positive impact on safety.

Committing to hire third party auditors who will report to an independent committee of board members has more practical near term significance than almost any conceivable regulatory action.

These board members will have a fiduciary duty. If they ignore a report from the third party auditors then a bad faith finding from a court is a real possibility. A D&O carrier could use this to deny coverage.

Really good outcome for ordinary Americans.

More effective and elegant than some ridiculous new regulatory body that would take months to do anything, then almost certainly done the wrong thing and along the way probably created a regulated oligopoly at the frontier which is the scariest potential outcome*

As I read the articles about the accord, it did occur to me that they were mostly written by political reporters who may have not understood the significance of the accord given their reporting beats are generally focused on public policy instead of corporate governance.

*Scariest because I do not trust any 5-20 individuals to make the best possible decisions about the direction of this technology. I want as many AIs as possible to maximize the odds that they encompass the diversity of human values across the world and richness of human variation. And I want an AI that shares my own personal values. Safety, freedom and the maximization of human agency through democratization, distribution and diffusion vs. centralization. History has spoken on the dangers of the latter path.

**Also SI not AI still adapting to the change but I do think better branding. Who wants artificial ingredients in their food?

Remember, my view of SF is warped by startup culture. 

Some thoughts that come to mind.

I could see myself moving back to Austin when I have family. For me I value working remotely, walkable city, meeting creative people. NYC is great for that. Austin is good for that if you live center of downtown which I did. 

Austin the people are so nice and so detached from work and want to have fun. Which is better than SF, where people have a frantic existential dread and constant worry of perminent underclass. At least in tech scene. 

There are lots of rich people in NYC, SF and to a lesser degree, ATX. The difference is that SF rich people are unbearable. NYC has a lot of cool rich creative people. 

Food in NYC is unmatched. Austin has good food. SF food is mid at best. Nothing is open late in SF and ATX. 

NYC People do have a frantic pace, almost culturally embedded… but it’s a buzz. It feels like a property of the city. Whereas in SF there’s no buzz. Just GRIND. GRIND GRIND. GRIND baby. 

NYC people aren’t “nice” like in ATX, that’s not the right word. They are not overtly friendly. This is really cool about Austin… people are just really nice. 

but in NYC people look after each other. Theres a city pride to NYC. Like they have a duty to look after each other. People are “nice”… in a NY way. It feels the most real. In SF i felt none of this. People aren’t nice or proud to be there. Again my opinion could be warped. 

Age anxiety.

Spent 24 hours using my Dot (Bluey)

- The voice experience is the highlight. Truly remarkable. (As you approach 30min+ I’ve run into problems)

Here’s an unfiltered list of feature requests and thoughts 

- make a better view for seeing codex threads it spins up. I think paying attention to the way Claude does Claude Code Projects (new version) would be useful. The way you can spin up new threads is quite nice. But the “projects” analogy doesn’t work. An agent (like dot) makes more sense.

- being able to voice call multiple dots and switch between the dot your talking to would be really cool. Especially if they have different voices. This allows you to do something while it’s working

- better animations when working. Sometimes hard to tell when the dot is working. 

- simplify the vocab around browser and computer - for instance, I asked my dot to use the browser… and it asked me “my vm browser, the codex browser, or chrome browser?” it was at this moment where I was like, omg there’s ALOT going on here. 

- however I was skeptical of dot being in the same app as chat, and codex. But now I’m starting to see the vision. It’s going to require ruthless prioritization and cutting surfaces. This is more codex feedback - even my most technical friends are telling me that chatgpt desktop is too intimating. 

- tbf I remember just 9 months ago I was like OpenAi is overcooking with Sora, Atlas, etc then they did 2 months of prioritization and they made codex… so I expect that’ll happen again now.

4 safety researchers just left OpenAI. 
Their next model should be really good.

text:
世事无常，生命有限。两年前肚子上长了个大包，医院建议割掉，嫌麻烦也没管。7 月初感染了，一开始保守治疗，吃抗生素、抹药，还越来越严重了。309 医院做了 B 超，发现囊肿已经长到了 3cm * 3cm * 2cm，还破裂感染了，说只能切开引流，留下开放创口慢慢长肉了。

老婆推荐我去北京中医医院。疮疡科王广宇主任一看，就说这也只能清创之后慢慢长肉了。当天下午就做了清创手术，把囊肿和附近烂掉的肉挖掉，留下一个 3cm * 3cm * 1.5cm 的大坑。

王主任说我这来看的太晚了，囊肿比鹌鹑蛋都大了，相当于一个小鸡蛋了。如果不感染的时候来切掉，创口可以缝合，半个月就能好。现在感染了，只能留下开放式创口，得天天换药一两个月了。

手术过程中肯定是疼的不行，本来以为麻药下去后会更疼，没想到一小时后就不怎么疼了。由于一牵拉到腹部就会疼，走路都跟跛了脚一样，医生说我这又不是腿上做了手术，用不着这样。

术后前三天，每天去医院换药，换药的时候肯定疼，但换完药之后过一个小时就不疼了。第三天换完药后医生说长得不错，给开了红纱条（引流条），让自己回去天天换药。

老婆一开始买了一些纱布、碘伏、酒精、镊子和剪刀，但家里怎么消毒倒成了麻烦。一开始是在蒸笼里蒸半个小时，感觉太麻烦了。

后来我发现无菌换药包只要不到 5 块钱一包，里面有一套无菌的镊子、碘伏、纱布，每天用一包就行了。只要一开始用消毒后的剪刀把红纱条剪好，后面就不用剪了。无菌换药包里面有两个镊子，一个是用来夹干净东西的（红纱条、碘伏），一个是用来接触伤口的。这些都是我们第一次知道。

为了方便洗澡，我们买了无菌敷贴，洗澡前贴上无菌敷贴，就不会进水，但一开始还是不敢洗澡，只敢用水冲腿、后背和洗头，上身用毛巾擦。

手术后 7 天的时候，大坑开始逐渐变浅、变小了，每天 1-2 毫米的样子，每天换药就不怎么疼了。

10 天的时候，我去医院复查，王主任告诉我说红纱条塞的太多了，把旁边的好肉都给腐蚀了，只要覆盖里面就行了。9 天的时候我腿上也长了一个皮脂腺囊肿，心想这还能转移呢，王主任正好看到，给开了一个复方化毒膏，抹了两天，囊肿就破了。这样每天连肚子带腿，要给两个地方换药消毒。

12 天的时候，大坑里的肉基本长平了，周围的皮也开始往中间爬，边缘处已经被新皮覆盖了。这比估计的快不少，本来以为得三四周才能长平的。

19 天的时候，肚子上的创面结痂了。腿上的囊肿小，好的快，一周就长好了。21 天的时候去复查，王主任说等痂掉了，就好了。终于可以贴着无菌敷贴洗澡了，不用擦身子了。25 天的时候痂掉了，露出了新长的嫩皮。28 天的时候，洗澡的时候也不贴无菌敷贴了。

今天距离手术已经过去两个多月，那里还是留下红红的一片肉，像皮下塞了一块鲜牛肉，按起来还是有点疼。可能得三四个月才能完全长好。

北京中医医院疮疡科王广宇主任真的不错，首先在感染的情况下一次就给切干净了，避免了开两刀（其他医院要先切开引流，消除感染后再完整切除），其次术后除了换药以外几乎没有疼痛，不影响正常睡觉和生活，最后好的也比想象的快，换了三周药，这么大的坑就长好了。

皮脂腺囊肿还是要趁没有感染的时候尽早切除，感染了太麻烦了。

His new company is http://doxx.net, a parallel internet designed to keep advertisers, trackers, and creepy VPNs out of your life.

Barrett joins a16z's Joel de la Garza to explain what it is and how it works: a private network where messages, calls, and files travel directly between people instead of through someone else's server, and where nobody needs your name, number, or email to reach you.

They also get into why most VPNs are "just entry and exit points," why you can't set policy on equipment you don't own, the day Barrett's plane lost power over Oakland on the way home from a16z, and the data center myths that drive him crazy.

quoted_tweet.author: David George
quoted_tweet.text:
Introducing our State of Markets pt 2, along with a companion podcast where we unpack the data and discuss what comes next.

Tech is the everything cycle.

Supply: putting the buildout in context, just passed railroads as % of GDP. The wisdom of Elon is real: the factory (or the datacenter!) is the product.

Demand: diffusion is so, so early. Median AI vendor spending in the top 1% of companies is 8x that of the top 10%. Only about 30% of S&P 500 companies report a quantified AI impact, which means there’s a substantial opportunity in connecting models to a company's data and workflows. Diffusion into companies is one of the main themes of the next 5 years.

We’re entering the agent work period. Only a few million users today, but applicable to billions of internet users with massive surplus created. META/GOOG monetize US users at $200+ per year today. Agent opportunity is much higher.

Mega-trends the next 5 years: Consumer agents, Robotics, Autonomy, AI x bio, Personal health, Diffusion into enterprise, New era of American Dynamism.

Much more in our SoM report here - https://www.a16z.news/p/state-of-markets-ii

Tips for AI video production: 

1) Use Claude to write yours prompts (Opus 5.5 is great)
Most pros don't write prompts by hand anymore 

2) Create character sheets before generating videos. For each asset. This will help with consistency. Create all assets before generating videos. Polish those. 

3) Every model has its strengths and weaknesses. Learn those and use models accordingly (like, Seedream 5.0 Pro is really good at skin textures; for video Seedance 2.5 but if you only have 2.0, use that, etc.)

4) Generate at 480 first while you're testing prompts and refining and iterating. No need to generate 1080 right away. Save your credits. 

5) A lot of times you'll have to batch generations instead of re-writing the prompt. Sometimes it's just a better option. 

6) If you know how to use Blender, use it for your scenes camera movement and consistency, if you don't know, use Claude to help you with Blender.
